I'm an actuary and software engineer with fifteen years modernizing how life & annuity insurers run their finance, actuarial, and capital operations across the US, Asia-Pacific, and the Middle East. I turn fragmented, manual processes into governed, scalable platforms that lower cost, strengthen controls, and give leadership faster, auditable numbers to act on.

Most recently I directed a greenfield build of the core Finance & Actuarial platforms — implementing automated, governed systems that replaced manual processes. I led the F&A technology transition that enabled a major reinsurance capital-release program, and today I continue to explore how AI can be leveraged for operational efficiencies releasing human capacity for value creation purposes.

I've spent my career across two disciplines that rarely sit together — actuarial modeling of liabilities, valuation, and capital, and the engineering that turns those models, and the data they depend on, into production systems. I am now bringing AI into that same regulated, high-stakes core. I don't hand over a deck and walk away; I own the operating model and live with the outcome. Connecting actuarial judgment, capital reporting, and delivery into one plan people can trust is where I do my best work — the perspective I brought to the keynote stage at Insurance Innovators in Nashville (2025).

I'm drawn to problems where insurance, capital, and technology meet — carriers and reinsurers modernizing their core, teams building the next generation of insurance and InsurTech platforms, and the investors and technologists backing them. Always open to a good conversation.
